scenarios.name: Ready for image input
scenarios.description: Empty conversation with a vision model selected; image control visible and audio control absent.

scenarios.name: Image response complete
scenarios.description: Uploaded landscape and text response visible; additional media controls disabled.

scenarios.name: Audio response complete
scenarios.description: Audio file, transcription and text response visible; one-file limit active.

scenarios.name: No transcription endpoint
scenarios.description: Audio workflow selected; ASR selector disabled and registration guidance visible.

scenarios.name: Text-only model
scenarios.description: Empty chat with a text model selected; no image or audio input controls in the DOM.

scenarios.name: File too large
scenarios.description: Persistent 10 MB validation error visible; no file accepted or uploaded.

scenarios.name: Transcription failed
scenarios.description: Audio attachment retained with persistent ASR failure message and retry controls.

scenarios.name: Registered endpoints
scenarios.description: Vision and ASR endpoints listed with editable audio transcription flags.

scenarios.name: No registered endpoints
scenarios.description: Empty endpoints state with registration call to action.

scenarios.name: Endpoint loading failed
scenarios.description: Connection error state visible with a retry button.
